"This app is a tool for extracting data points from a two-dimensional graph with a linear scale.

 You just need to either load an image from your device or take a picture, mark the points and enter four parameters of the graph.

 The data table is shown in the app itself and can be shared as a csv file.

 In order to load images from the camera, you need to give the app permission to access the camera.

 JPEG files are created from the images loaded in the app by the user. They are saved in the app folder for later recovering and editing by the user. These JPEG files are not shared by the app and are exclusively stored on the user's device.

 CSV files are created after the optional sharing operation and saved on the device's storage folder.

 Kolekti Punkton opens a sharing window so that the user can choose another app installed on the device (such as WhatsApp, Gmail and Outlook) to share the file."

"Kolekti Punkton processes two-dimensional graphs with linear scales. In the current version, the logarithmic scale is not included.

 CSV files are created after the optional sharing operation and saved on the device's storage folder.

 These files have two data sets for comma and period as decimal separators.

 Processing graphs with very different magnitudes between abscissa and ordinate generally does not leads to results very close to the true ones due to the limitation in showing these types of graphs in a reasonable size on the screen.

 In order to give an example of the app usage, the graph below with a linear scale was chosen."
This graph, saved as a JPG file, can be loaded in the app from the \"load from gallery\" button shown in the image below.

"Now points can be marked: the origin, the extreme values on the axes and the points on the curve.

 After the first point marked on the curve, we can press the automatic points selection button.

 In this example, a wired mouse connected to the smartphone via a USB-OTG adapter was used to mark the origin, the extreme values on the axes and the first point on the curve. Then the automatic points selection button was pressed.

"For each value of x the automatic selection looks for only one value of y like a mathematical function that associates each element of a set X to a single element of a set Y.

 If there are areas with few marked points, you can consider the manual selection.

 The graph parameters must be informed in 4 fields. Then click on the Save button."
The data is now available on the Data Table Tab.
This data table can be shared as a CSV file that can be opened in several spreadsheet editors and in simple text editors.
It is possible to share through many apps such as WhatsApp, Gmail and Outlook.

string-array.item: Open file: it opens a list box for choosing a saved file.
Delete file: it deletes all the file data. The file no longer exists in the app.
Clear file: it deletes all the file data. The file still exists in the app and can be selected in Open file.
Settings: you can choose the marker color, the marker size, the app theme, the auto-save and set the specificity.
